── About Us ──
Cairo's Ultimate Pet Paradise
Pets Mall is Cairo's most comprehensive pet store — a one-stop destination where every pet parent finds exactly what their furry family member needs. From the finest international pet food brands to professional grooming and expert veterinary care.
With two convenient branches in 6th of October and Mohandseen, we're always close to you. Our slogan "All in 1" isn't just a tagline — it's our promise.
✓ Premium Dog & Cat Products
✓ Professional Grooming Salon
